description: A forward operating base commander must publish the day's generator load sequence for four essential support activities and record the power-control actions required by each section.

shared_context.S1: The main generator can support only one of the four planned high-load activities at a time.
shared_context.S2: Today's power-control period runs from 0800 to 1600 and has four available two-hour blocks: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, 1200-1400, and 1400-1600.
shared_context.S3: The four activities that must be scheduled are the generator load test, clinic refrigeration transfer, communications-battery recharge, and water-point pumping.
shared_context.S4: Col. Mercer issues the binding power schedule, and the routine 0700 power-control board meeting is used for each section to report changes before the schedule is published.

PF1.text: Maj. Singh confirmed from the electrician's inspection sheet this morning that the generator load test must be the first activity, in the 0800-1000 block, so the breaker settings can be verified before any other high-load connection; the inspection sheet has not yet been attached to the command brief.

PF2.text: Capt. Alvarez confirmed with the medical-supply custodian that the clinic refrigeration transfer must use the 1000-1200 block, when the replacement cold-storage unit and its qualified technician are both available; the clinic transfer note is still in the medical section's working folder.

PF3.text: Lt. Brooks confirmed that the communications-battery recharge requires the stabilized output available only after the generator test and must occupy the 1200-1400 block because the signal technician is conducting the configuration check then; the updated signal work card is not yet on the power board.

PF4.text: SFC Holloway confirmed that water-point pumping must occupy the 1400-1600 block because the pump crew will connect the treated-water manifold only after the generator and refrigeration transfers are complete; the revised pumping sequence remains in the water-point log.

acceptance_conditions: The generator load test must be scheduled for 0800-1000.
The clinic refrigeration transfer must be scheduled for 1000-1200.
The communications-battery recharge must be scheduled for 1200-1400.
Water-point pumping must be scheduled for 1400-1600.
The generator sequencing requirement must be cited in the commander's justification.

decisive_facts.why: The inspection-sheet requirement changes the generator load test from an uncommitted activity to the exact first block, 0800-1000, and supplies the fact required for the cited justification.
The custodian and technician availability changes the clinic refrigeration transfer to the exact 1000-1200 block.
The stabilized-output and technician requirement changes the communications-battery recharge to the exact 1200-1400 block.
The manifold-connection sequence changes water-point pumping to the exact final block, 1400-1600.
